thread:
deploy-bot: Initiating rollout v3.0.0 -> us-west (change window 03/21 10:00-12:00 UTC). Traffic plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. Preflight checks passed. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/efgh
rachel: quick pulse — embeddings route p95 jumped ~300ms in the last 3m, tracing shows DB pool wait hotspots :eyes:
devin: i'm seeing 502s coming back from the embed-service with upstream: postgres timeout errors in the logs
kyle: what's our guard? if 5xx > 0.8% for 5m we pause. Also watch db connection errors > 10/min
rachel: current 5m 5xx = 1.1% and DB conn errors = 18 in last 5m. Recommend hold at 5% and don't advance
deploy-bot: Pausing rollout at 5% per @rachel. Canary hold active. Notifying connected channels.
ops-bot: Triggering automated runbook: Run `pg_stat_activity` snapshot and increase pool size via feature-flag if needed. See runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/db-pool-surge
devin: collected stack snippet: `ERROR: canceling statement due to statement timeout at character 256` repeated across canary nodes. Also `pq: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections`
kyle: looks like pool exhaustion. Can we pin canaries to instance-class a2-highmem temporarily or enable connection pooling (pgbouncer) for canary group?
rachel: quick mitigation: scale replicas for embed-service from 4->8 in us-west; also bump DB max_connections by 50 for canary window. I'll run scaling now
deploy-bot: Scaling embed-service replicas to 8 in us-west. DB max_connections change applied to canary namespace. Monitoring lag for config push.
ops-bot: Notifying infra-team and setting a 30m reminder to revert DB max_connections to baseline after rollout.
devin: post-scale metrics: 5xx dropped to 0.25% within 4m, p95 back to baseline. No more pg timeouts in logs
kyle: good. Keep at 5% for 20m and run synthetic queries to validate under sustained QPS. If stable, move to 20% then 60% with 15m holds
rachel: I'll capture traces and add to the release ticket: `v3.0.0: hold at 5% due to DB pool pressure; scaled embed replicas and increased DB connections for canary. Investigating pooling behavior.`
oncall-bot: Alerting channels: eng-db, eng-runtime, eng-sre. Current oncall: @kyle
devin: follow-up action: create infra ticket to evaluate connection pooling + pgbouncer for embed workloads and add test for connection surge in CI
deploy-bot: Canary resumed and advanced to 20% after 25m hold. Watching SLOs closely.
rachel: running `hey -n 500 -c 20 -H "x-canary: true" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` to validate under load
kyle: ack. If any regression >0.5% 5xx during the next 30m we revert to v2.11.x and open priority incident
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled to revert DB max_connections and scale replicas after final ramp to 100% or manual approval
rachel: thumbs up. Will follow up with post-deploy notes and an operational checklist to avoid DB pool exhaustion in future releases
